card.name: Ending of eponym and gut terms
card.fires_on: The last piece of a split medical name or term, such as 'an' in Fontan, 'ugh' in Child-Pugh, 'unal' in Jejunal, or 'gut' and 'failure' after short and intestinal.

modes.label: Eponym endings

modes.label: Gut-related terms
modes.description: Closing word of gut-related terms such as jejunal, short gut, intestinal failure.
